$description: Scrim (library wave 4, lane C): the translucent layer behind a modal layer or over a busy region, in the scrim role or the canvas color at an opacity of the scale.

scrim-background.$description: The modal and light scrim: the scrim role.

scrim-opacity.$description: The modal scrim: the middle opacity, as the dialog's backdrop.

scrim-light-opacity.$description: The light scrim: the low opacity.

scrim-inverse-background.$description: The inverse scrim (a veil): the canvas color.

scrim-inverse-opacity.$description: The inverse scrim: the high opacity, so the content under it stays faintly readable.

scrim-z-index.$description: A scrim over the window: the overlay layer, under the modal layer it backs.

scrim-contained-z-index.$description: A scrim over one region: one layer over the region's content.
